question: Is fail-closed `update_partial` plus status/Doctor inspection an acceptable initial recovery contract for external package and Gateway mutations, or must this PR add an operation-identity reconciliation/retry workflow before merge?
rationale: Tests can verify local failure handling, but only maintainers can choose the user-facing recovery guarantee for unreceipted external mutations and the acceptable operator burden for this experimental lifecycle.

options.title: Require live recovery proof first
options.body: Keep the current bounded contract, but require exact-head redacted package and Gateway failure/recovery evidence that shows the documented status/Doctor and fresh-plan recovery path.

options.title: Require reconciliation before merge
options.body: Pause this slice until it adds durable operation identity and a supported retry/reconcile flow for uncertain external mutations.

options.title: Accept the current experimental contract
options.body: Approve fail-closed partial state as the initial behavior after reviewing the risk and clearly documenting the operator recovery limitation.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the current bounded contract, but require exact-head redacted package and Gateway failure/recovery evidence that shows the documented status/Doctor and fresh-plan recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment identifies the unresolved recovery and aggregate-consent requirements in concrete product terms.
